affinity.title: Cache-aware routing
affinity.description: New sessions go to the member with the best availability score (load, health, public-egress, and cost). When those scores tie, prefer a runtime that may still hold a matching instruction prefix. System-prompt-aware routing is part of this switch. After an assistant or tool turn, prefer the member that served the conversation so far. A long conversation can outweigh modest load or a half-open member; a large queue still spills the request.
affinity.privacy: Only tenant-scoped HMAC digests and prompt-free routing metadata are stored. A match predicts cache residency; it does not prove it.

fields.localWaitBudgetMsHint: A request queued for local capacity waits at most this long before guarded routing may try public providers; the request's own deadline can end the wait sooner.
fields.nameHint: Display-only label for this pool. It never appears in API requests or routes and can be changed later.
fields.slugHint: Identifier used in API requests and routes. Changing it later changes how the pool is addressed, so keep it stable.
fields.memberConcurrencyLimitHint: Pool-wide cap on the total concurrent requests this pool may run on the shared physical runtime. Members inherit this pool cap by default; a per-member override gives only that member its own ceiling.
fields.memberContextCeilingHint: Optional cap on counted request context for admission. Members without their own ceiling inherit this one; ceiling plus margin must fit the physical maximum.
fields.finiteSpendProtection: I will configure a finite provider spending limit before attaching a public target.
fields.publicEgressAcknowledged: I understand which request data can leave this deployment.
fields.recommendedSurfaceHint: Auto-set once when the pool first has primary members: the best-ranked API shared by those primary members, native support preferred with strict adaptation as fallback. It is not recomputed afterward except auto-repair. Any API that every primary member can serve natively or through strict adaptation is valid.
fields.reservedSlots: Reserved slots on the shared runtime
fields.reservedSlotsHint: Reserves this many slots of the shared physical runtime for this pool. Other pools may use them only when idle, only under their borrowing policy, and never while a higher-priority queued request of this pool needs the slot. Cannot exceed this pool's ceiling.
fields.physicalCountStrategyHint: How the runtime counts request tokens before the context-ceiling check. The default, conservative estimate, deliberately overcounts (serialized UTF-8 bytes ÷ 3 with a 1.2 safety factor) instead of trusting tokenizer or engine counts; the other strategies use the configured tokenizer, a template-aware counter, or the engine's reported count.
fields.contextMarginHint: Headroom reserved below the ceiling: admission requires counted tokens plus this margin to fit the ceiling and the physical maximum. Must stay below the ceiling.
fields.memberContextInheritHint: Inherits the optional pool ceiling; no member ceiling is set.
fields.borrowPolicyHint: Whether this pool may run on idle slots other pools reserved on the shared runtime. NEVER keeps it off them; WHEN_IDLE (default) allows it unless a higher-priority queued request of theirs needs the slot.
fields.protocolAdaptationEnabled: Allow strict protocol adaptation when a native surface is unavailable
fields.protocolAdaptationHint: Adaptation strictly translates requests between API surfaces when a member has no native one. It requires the deployment protocol-adaptation gate; without it the non-native options stay disabled.
fields.affinityEnabledHint: On by default. Requests that continue the same conversation prefer the same member to reuse its warm caches; turn this off to route purely by load.
fields.affinityTtlSecondsHint: How long an affinity record survives without reuse before it expires.
fields.affinityMaxRecordsHint: Cap on affinity records kept per member target; the least recently used beyond this cap are deleted first.
fields.affinityPrefixWeightHint: Score added per matched conversation-prefix depth for continued conversations, favoring members with the longest warm prefix.
fields.affinityConversationWeightHint: Score added when a member already holds a record for the same explicit conversation.
fields.affinityConfirmedCacheWeightHint: Extra score when the member's warm prefix was confirmed by the engine cache.
fields.affinityLoadPenaltyWeightHint: Score subtracted per point of normalized member load (active and waiting), steering new requests to quieter members.
fields.enableMemberOverride: Customize this member instead of inheriting pool controls
